1 Op AI Proxy.event_text: 1 Op Proxy.  For AI Use Only.
1 Op AI Proxy.name: 1 Op AI Proxy

1945 UK Election.event_text:
1:   Labour wins in a huge landslide; Tories fail to reach 100 seats in the Commons. US shies from left-wing elements. US Influence in the UK is reduced by 2.
2/3: Labour wins in a landslide. No effect.
4/5: Coalition government. Socialist Governments event has no effect in Turns 1 or 2.
6:   Tories return to power; Churchill and Eden dominate. Move Socialist Governments to the Mid War deck; Suez Crisis event has no effect (permanently).
1945 UK Election.name: 1945 UK Election

2 Op AI Proxy.event_text: 2 Op Proxy.  For AI Use Only.
2 Op AI Proxy.name: 2 Op AI Proxy

3 Op AI Proxy.event_text: 3 Op Proxy.  For AI Use Only.
3 Op AI Proxy.name: 3 Op AI Proxy

4 Op AI Proxy.event_text: 4 Op Proxy.  For AI Use Only.
4 Op AI Proxy.name: 4 Op AI Proxy

ABM Treaty.event_text:
Improve DEFCON one level.
Then player may Conduct Operations as if they played a 4 Ops card.
ABM Treaty.name: ABM Treaty

AWACS Sale to Saudis.event_text: US receives 2 Influence in Saudi Arabia. Muslim Revolution may no longer be played as an event.
AWACS Sale to Saudis.name: AWACS Sale to Saudis

Acheson.event_text: Add 1 to the die roll total for the current Crisis.
Acheson.name: Acheson

Africa Scoring.event_text:
Both sides score:
Presence: 1
Domination: 4
Control: 6
+1 per controlled Battleground Country in Region
Africa Scoring.name: Africa Scoring

Aldrich Ames Remix.event_text: US player exposes his hand to USSR player for remainder of turn. USSR then chooses one card from US hand; this card is discarded.
Aldrich Ames Remix.name: Aldrich Ames Remix

Alliance for Progress.event_text: US gains 1 VP for each US controlled Battleground country in Central America and South America.
Alliance for Progress.name: Alliance for Progress

An Evil Empire.event_text:
Cancels/Prevents Flower Power.
US gains 1 VP.
An Evil Empire.name: An Evil Empire

Andropov.event_text: Subtract 1 from the die roll total for the current Crisis.
Andropov.name: Andropov

Arab-Israeli War.event_text:
A Pan-Arab Coalition invades Israel. Roll one die and subtract 1 for US Control of Israel and for US-controlled country adjacent to Israel. USSR Victory on modified die roll 4-6. USSR adds 2 to Military Ops Track.
Effects of Victory: USSR gains 2 VP and replaces all US Influence in Israel with USSR Influence.
Arab-Israeli War.name: Arab-Israeli War

Arms Race.event_text: Compare each player's status on the Military Operations Track. If Phasing Player has more Military Operations points, he scores 1 VP. If Phasing Player has more Military Operations points and has met the Required Military Operations amount, he scores 3 VP instead.
Arms Race.name: Arms Race

Asia Scoring.event_text:
Both sides score:
Presence: 3
Domination: 7
Control: 9
+1 per controlled Battleground Country in Region
+1 per Country controlled that is adjacent to enemy superpower
Asia Scoring.name: Asia Scoring

Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You.event_text: US player may discard up to entire hand (including Scoring cards) and draw replacements from the deck. The number of cards discarded must be decided prior to drawing any replacements.
Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You.name: Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You...

Bear Trap.event_text: On next action round, USSR player must discard an Operations card worth 2 or more and roll 1-4 to cancel this event. Repeat each USSR player Action Round until successful or no appropriate cards remain. If out of appropriate cards, the USSR player may only play scoring cards until the next turn.
Bear Trap.name: Bear Trap

Beria.event_text: Cancel effect of US card for the current Crisis.
Beria.name: Beria

Berlin Wall.event_text: Add 2 Influence in East Germany and, if you are behind or tied with the US in the Space Race, advance your Space Race marker by one box.
Berlin Wall.name: Berlin Wall

Blockade.event_text: Unless US Player immediately discards a '3' or more value Operations card, eliminate all US Influence in West Germany.
Blockade.name: Blockade

Brezhnev Doctrine.event_text: All further Operations cards played by the USSR this turn increase their Ops value by one (to a maximum of 4).
Brezhnev Doctrine.name: Brezhnev Doctrine

Brush War.event_text:
Attack any country with a stability of 1 or 2. Roll a die and subtract 1 for every adjacent enemy controlled country. Success on 3-6. Player adds 3 to his Military Ops Track.
Effects of Victory: Player gains 1 VP and replaces all opponent's Influence with his Influence.
Brush War.name: Brush War

CIA Created.event_text:
USSR reveals hand this turn.
Then the US may Conduct Operations as if they played a 1 Op card.
CIA Created.name: CIA Created

COMECON.event_text: Add 1 USSR Influence in each of four non-US Controlled countries in Eastern Europe.
COMECON.name: COMECON

Camp David Accords.event_text:
US gains 1 VP.
US receives 1 Influence in Israel, Jordan and Egypt.
Arab-Israeli War event no longer playable.
Camp David Accords.name: Camp David Accords

Captured Nazi Scientist.event_text: Advance player's Space Race marker one box.
Captured Nazi Scientist.name: Captured Nazi Scientist

Central America Scoring.event_text:
Both sides score:
Presence: 1
Domination: 3
Control: 5
+1 per controlled Battleground Country in Region
+1 per Country controlled that is adjacent to enemy superpower
Central America Scoring.name: Central America Scoring

Che.event_text: USSR may immediately make a Coup attempt using this card's Operations value against a non-battleground country in Central America, South America, or Africa. If the Coup removes any US Influence, USSR may make a second Coup attempt against a different target under the same restrictions.
Che.name: Che

Chernobyl.event_text: The US player may designate one Region. For the remainder of the turn the USSR may not add additional Influence to that Region by the play of Operations Points via placing Influence.
Chernobyl.name: Chernobyl

Chinese Civil War.event_text:
1:   Sino-Soviet relations remain cordial, even if strained on occasion. Remove Ussuri River Skirmish from the game.
2/3: US aid slow to arrive; Huaihai campaign knocks out Nationalists. No effect.
4/5: Nationalists prolong struggle with early US aid. The China Card begins face down.
6:   US rapidly reinforces Chiang; Nationalist retain a stronghold on the mainland. Apply the 4-5 result, and Taiwan is now permanently a Battleground country. Add 3 US Influence in Taiwan during setup. Replace Formosan Resolution with the Nationalist China card.
Chinese Civil War.name: Chinese Civil War

Colonial Rear Guards.event_text: Add 1 US Influence in each of four different African and/or Southeast Asian countries.
Colonial Rear Guards.name: Colonial Rear Guards

Containment.event_text: All further Operations cards played by US this turn add one to their value (to a maximum of 4).
Containment.name: Containment

Cuban Missile Crisis.event_text: Set DEFCON to Level 2. Any further Coup attempt by your opponent this turn, anywhere on the board, will result in Global Thermonuclear War. Your opponent will lose the game. This event may be cancelled at any time if the USSR player removes two Influence from Cuba or the US player removes 2 Influence from either West Germany or Turkey.
Cuban Missile Crisis.name: Cuban Missile Crisis

Cultural Revolution.event_text: If the US has 'The China Card', claim it face up and available for play. If the USSR already had it, USSR gains 1 VP.
Cultural Revolution.name: Cultural Revolution

De Gaulle Leads France.event_text: Remove 2 US Influence in France, add 1 USSR Influence. Cancels effects of NATO for France.
De Gaulle Leads France.name: De Gaulle Leads France

De-Stalinization.event_text: USSR may relocate up to 4 Influence points to non-US controlled countries. No more than 2 Influence may be placed in the same country.
De-Stalinization.name: De-Stalinization

Decolonization.event_text: Add one USSR Influence in each of any four African and/or SE Asian countries.
Decolonization.name: Decolonization

Defectors.event_text:
Play in Headline Phase to cancel USSR Headline event, including Scoring Card. Cancelled card returns to the Discard Pile.
If Defectors played by USSR during Soviet action round, US gains 1 VP (unless played on the Space Race).
Defectors.name: Defectors

Don't Wait for the Translation.event_text: If the US is behind in Military Operations, the US scores 2 VP.
Don't Wait for the Translation.name: Don't Wait for the Translation

Duck and Cover.event_text:
Degrade DEFCON one level.
Then US player earns VPs equal to 5 minus current DEFCON level.
Duck and Cover.name: Duck and Cover

Dulles.event_text: Cancel effect of USSR card for the current Crisis.
Dulles.name: Dulles

East European Unrest.event_text:
In Early or Mid War: Remove 1 USSR Influence from three countries in Eastern Europe.
In Late War: Remove 2 USSR Influence from three countries in Eastern Europe.
East European Unrest.name: East European Unrest

Europe Scoring.event_text:
Both sides score:
Presence: 3
Domination: 7
Control: VICTORY
+1 per controlled Battleground Country in Region
+1 per Country controlled that is adjacent to enemy superpower
Europe Scoring.name: Europe Scoring

Europe Scoring - Allied Berlin.event_text:
Both sides score:
Presence: 3
Domination: 6
Control: 6
+1 per controlled Battleground Country in Region
+1 per Country controlled that is adjacent to enemy superpower
Europe Scoring - Allied Berlin.name: Europe Scoring - Allied Berlin

Fidel.event_text: Remove all US Influence in Cuba. USSR gains sufficient Influence in Cuba for Control.
Fidel.name: Fidel

First Lightning.event_text:
Play at the same time you play a card with a US-affiliated Event for its Operations.
Ignore the event text and place the card in the discard pile.
Reduce DEFCON by 1 if this card is played for Operations or its Event.
First Lightning.name: First Lightning

Five-Year Plan.event_text: USSR player must randomly discard one card. If the card is a US associated Event, the Event occurs immediately. If the card is a USSR associated Event or and Event applicable to both players, then the card must be discarded without triggering the Event.
Five-Year Plan.name: Five-Year Plan

Flower Power.event_text:
USSR gains 2 VP for every subsequently US played 'war card' (played as an Event or Operations) unless played on the Space Race.
War Cards: Arab-Israeli War, Korean War, Brush War, Indo-Pakistani War or Iran-Iraq War.
This event cancelled by 'An Evil Empire'.
Flower Power.name: Flower Power

Formosan Resolution.event_text: Taiwan shall be treated as a Battleground country for scoring purposes, if the US controls Taiwan when the Asia Scoring Card is played or during Final Scoring at the end of Turn 10. Taiwan is not a battleground country for any other game purpose. This card is discarded after US play of 'The China Card'.
Formosan Resolution.name: Formosan Resolution

Glasnost.event_text:
USSR gains 2 VP.
Improve DEFCON one level.
If The Reformer is in effect, then the USSR may place Influence or attempt Realignments as if they played a 4 Ops card.
Glasnost.name: Glasnost

Grain Sales to Soviets.event_text: Randomly choose one card from USSR hand. Play it or return it. If Soviet player has no cards, or returned, use this card to conduct Operations normally.
Grain Sales to Soviets.name: Grain Sales to Soviets

How I Learned to Stop Worrying.event_text: Set the DEFCON at any level you want (1-5). This event counts as 5 Military Operations for the purpose of required Military Operations.
How I Learned to Stop Worrying.name: How I Learned to Stop Worrying

Independent Reds.event_text: Adds sufficient US Influence in either Yugoslavia, Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary, or Czechoslavakia to equal USSR Influence.
Independent Reds.name: Independent Reds

Indo-Pakistani War.event_text: India or Pakistan invades the other (player's choice). Roll one die and subtract 1 for every opponent-controlled country adjacent to the target of the invasion. Player Victory on modified die roll of 4-6. Player adds 2 to Military Ops Track. Effects of Victory: Player gains 2 VP and replaces all opponent's Influence in target country with his Influence.
Indo-Pakistani War.name: Indo-Pakistani War

Iran-Contra Scandal.event_text: All US Realignment rolls have a -1 die roll modifier for the remainder of the turn.
Iran-Contra Scandal.name: Iran-Contra Scandal

Iran-Iraq War.event_text:
Iran or Iraq invades the other (player's choice). Roll one die and subtract 1 for every opponent-controlled country adjacent to target of invasion. Player Victory on modified die roll of 4-6. Player adds 2 to Military Ops Track
Effects of Victory: Player gains 2 VP and replaces opponent's Influence in target country with his own.
Iran-Iraq War.name: Iran-Iraq War

Iranian Hostage Crisis.event_text:
Remove all US Influence in Iran. Add 2 USSR Influence in Iran.
Doubles the effect of Terrorism card against US.
Iranian Hostage Crisis.name: Iranian Hostage Crisis

Israel.event_text:
1:   Ben-Gurion coalition shaky. Apply the 2-3 result; USSR receives 2 Influence in the Middle East during setup (no more than 1 per country).
2/3: Soviets fund anti-Israel forces. USSR receives 1 Influence in Syria during setup.
4/5: Both superpowers moderately distracted. No effect.
6:   Irgun disarms; Palstinians follow suit. US receives an additional 1 Influence in each of Israel, Lebanon, and Jordan during setup.
Israel.name: Israel

John Paul II Elected Pope.event_text:
Remove 2 USSR Influence in Poland and then add 1 US Influence in Poland.
Allows play of 'Solidarity'.
John Paul II Elected Pope.name: John Paul II Elected Pope

Junta.event_text:
Place 2 Influence in any one Central or South American country.
Then you may make a free Coup attempt or Realignment roll in one of these regions (using this card's Operations Value).
Junta.name: Junta

Kennan.event_text: Add 1 to the die roll total for the current Crisis.
Kennan.name: Kennan

Khrushchev.event_text: Subtract 1 from the die roll total for the current Crisis.
Khrushchev.name: Khrushchev

Kitchen Debates.event_text: If the US controls more Battleground countries than the USSR, poke opponent in chest and gain 2 VP!
Kitchen Debates.name: Kitchen Debates

Korean War.event_text:
North Korea invades South Korea. Roll one die and subtract 1 for every US Controlled country adjacent to South Korea. USSR Victory on modified die roll 4-6. USSR add 2 to Military Ops Track.
Effects of Victory: USSR gains 2 VP and replaces all US Influence in South Korea with USSR Influence.
Korean War.name: Korean War

Kremlin Flu.event_text: US takes Operations as if this card were played as Operations. USSR must play a scoring card on its next Action Round if it holds one; if no scoring card is in the USSR hand, the USSR forfeits its next Action Round.
Kremlin Flu.name: Kremlin Flu

Latin American Death Squads.event_text: All of the player's Coup attempts in Central and South America are +1 for the remainder of the turn, while all opponent's Coup attempts are -1 for the remainder of the turn.
Latin American Death Squads.name: Latin American Death Squads

Latin American Debt Crisis.event_text: Unless the US Player immediately discards a '3' or greater Operations card, double USSR Influence in two countries in South America.
Latin American Debt Crisis.name: Latin American Debt Crisis

Liberation Theology.event_text: Add 3 USSR Influence in Central America, no more than 2 per country.
Liberation Theology.name: Liberation Theology

Lone Gunman.event_text: US player reveals his hand. Then the USSR may Conduct Operations as if they played a 1 Op card.
Lone Gunman.name: Lone Gunman

Marine Barracks Bombing.event_text: Remove all US Influence in Lebanon plus remove 2 additional US Influence from anywhere in the Middle East.
Marine Barracks Bombing.name: Marine Barracks Bombing

Marshall.event_text: Add 2 to the die roll total for the current Crisis.
Marshall.name: Marshall

Marshall Plan.event_text:
Allows play of NATO.
Add one US Influence in each of seven non-USSR Controlled Western European countries.
Marshall Plan.name: Marshall Plan

Middle East Scoring.event_text:
Both sides score:
Presence: 3
Domination: 5
Control: 7
+1 per controlled Battleground Country in Region
Middle East Scoring.name: Middle East Scoring

Missile Envy.event_text:
Exchange this card for your opponent's highest valued Operations card in his hand. If two or more cards are tied, opponent chooses.
If the exchanged card contains your event, or an event applicable to both players, it occurs immediately. If it contains opponent's event, use Operations value without triggering event. Opponent must use this card for Operations during his next action round.
Missile Envy.name: Missile Envy

Mobutu Sese Seko.event_text: Zaire's stability number permanently becomes 3. Add 2 US Influence in Zaire.
Mobutu Sese Seko.name: Mobutu Sese Seko

Molotov.event_text: Subtract 2 from the die roll total for the current Crisis.
Molotov.name: Molotov

Muslim Revolution.event_text: Remove all US Influence in two of the following countries: Sudan, Iran, Iraq, Egypt, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Syria, Jordan.
Muslim Revolution.name: Muslim Revolution

NATO.event_text:
Play after 'Marshall Plan' or 'Warsaw Pact'.
USSR player may no longer make Coup or Realignment rolls in any US Controlled countries in Europe. US Controlled countries in Europe may not be attacked by play of the Brush War event.
NATO.name: NATO

NORAD.event_text: If the US controls Canada, the US may add 1 Influence to any country already containing US Influence at the conclusion of any Action Round in which the DEFCON marker moves to the '2' box. This event cancelled by 'Quagmire'.
NORAD.name: NORAD

Nasser.event_text: Add 2 USSR Influence in Egypt. Remove half (rounded up) of the US Influence in Egypt.
Nasser.name: Nasser

Nationalist China.event_text: US places 3 Influence in Asia, no more than 1 per country.
Nationalist China.name: Nationalist China

Nixon Plays The China Card.event_text: If US has 'The China Card', gain 2 VP. Otherwise, US player receives 'The China Card' now, face down and unavailable for immediate play.
Nixon Plays The China Card.name: Nixon Plays The China Card

Non-Aligned Movement.event_text:
Select India or a country in Africa, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, or South America with at least 2 US and 2 USSR Influence.
Remove all Influence from that country, then take the next four cards from the top of the draw pile and put them in the discard pile (resuffling if necessary).
Non-Aligned Movement.name: Non-Aligned Movement

North Sea Oil.event_text:
OPEC event is no longer playable.
US may play 8 cards this turn.
North Sea Oil.name: North Sea Oil

Nuclear Subs.event_text: US Coup attempts in Battleground Countries do not affect the DEFCON track for the remainder of the turn (does not affect Cuban Missile Crisis).
Nuclear Subs.name: Nuclear Subs

Nuclear Test Ban.event_text: Player earns VPs equal to the current DEFCON level minus 2, then improve DEFCON two levels.
Nuclear Test Ban.name: Nuclear Test Ban

OAS Founded.event_text: Add 2 US Influence in Central America and/or South America.
OAS Founded.name: OAS Founded

OPEC.event_text:
USSR gains 1VP for each of the following countries he controls:
Egypt, Iran, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Gulf States, and Venezuela.
Unplayable as an event if 'North Sea Oil' is in effect.
OPEC.name: OPEC

Olympic Games.event_text: Player sponsors Olympics. Opponent may participate or boycott. If Opponent participates, each player rolls one die, with the sponsor adding 2 to his roll. High roll gains 2 VP. Reroll ties If Opponent boycotts, degrade DEFCON one level and the Sponsor may Conduct Operations as if they played a 4 Ops card.
Olympic Games.name: Olympic Games

One Small Step....event_text: If you are behind on the Space Race Track, play this card to move your marker two boxes forward on the Space Rack Track, gaining the VP value of the second box only.
One Small Step....name: One Small Step...

Ortega Elected in Nicaragua.event_text: Remove all US Influence from Nicaragua. Then USSR may make one free Coup attempt (with this card's Operations value) in a country adjacent to Nicaragua.
Ortega Elected in Nicaragua.name: Ortega Elected in Nicaragua

Our Man In Tehran.event_text: If the US controls at least one Middle East country, the US player draws the top 5 cards from the draw pile. They may reveal and then discard any or all of these drawn cards without triggering the Event. Any remaining drawn cards are returned to the draw deck, and it is reshuffled.
Our Man In Tehran.name: Our Man In Tehran

Panama Canal Returned.event_text: Add 1 US Influence in Panama, Costa Rica, and Venezuela.
Panama Canal Returned.name: Panama Canal Returned

Pershing II Deployed.event_text:
USSR gains 1 VP.
Remove 1 US Influence from up to three countries in Western Europe.
Pershing II Deployed.name: Pershing II Deployed

Portuguese Empire Crumbles.event_text: Add 2 USSR Influence in both SE African States and Angola.
Portuguese Empire Crumbles.name: Portuguese Empire Crumbles

Puppet Governments.event_text: US may add 1 Influence in three countries that currently contain no Influence from either power.
Puppet Governments.name: Puppet Governments

Quagmire.event_text: On next action round, US player must discard an Operations card worth 2 or more and roll 1-4 to cancel this event. Repeat each US player Action round until successful or no appropriate cards remain. If out of appropriate cards, the US player may only play scoring cards until the next turn.
Quagmire.name: Quagmire

Reagan Bombs Libya.event_text: US gains 1 VP for every 2 USSR Influence in Libya.
Reagan Bombs Libya.name: Reagan Bombs Libya

Red Scare/Purge.event_text: All further Operations cards played by your opponent this turn are -1 to their value (to a minimum of 1 Op).
Red Scare/Purge.name: Red Scare/Purge

Romanian Abdication.event_text: Remove all US Influence in Romania. USSR gains sufficient Influence in Romania for Control.
Romanian Abdication.name: Romanian Abdication

Sadat Expels Soviets.event_text: Remove all USSR Influence in Egypt and add one US Influence.
Sadat Expels Soviets.name: Sadat Expels Soviets

Salt Negotiations.event_text:
Improve DEFCON two levels.
Further Coup attempts incur -1 die roll modifier for both players for the remainder of the turn.
Player may sort through discard pile and reclaim one non-scoring card, after revealing it to their opponent.
Salt Negotiations.name: Salt Negotiations

Shuttle Diplomacy.event_text: Play in front of US player. During the next scoring of the Middle East or Asia (whichever comes first), subtract one Battleground country from USSR total, then put this card in the discard pile. Does not count for Final Scoring at the end of Turn 10.
Shuttle Diplomacy.name: Shuttle Diplomacy

Socialist Governments.event_text:
Unplayable as an event if 'The Iron Lady' is in effect.
Remove US Influence in Western Europe by a total of 3 Influence points, removing no more than 2 per country.
Socialist Governments.name: Socialist Governments

Solidarity.event_text:
Playable as an event only if John Paul II Elected Pope is in effect.
Add 3 US Influence in Poland.
Solidarity.name: Solidarity

_seq.description: Add Influence Adjacent to South Africa

South African Unrest.event_text: USSR either adds 2 Influence in South Africa or adds 1 Influence in South Africa and 2 Influence in any countries adjacent to South Africa.
South African Unrest.name: South African Unrest

South America Scoring.event_text:
Both sides score:
Presence: 2
Domination: 5
Control: 6
+1 per controlled Battleground Country in Region
South America Scoring.name: South America Scoring

Southeast Asia Scoring.event_text:
Both sides score:
1 VP each for Control of: Burma, Cambodia/Laos,
    Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Phillipines
2 VP for Control of Thailand
Southeast Asia Scoring.name: Southeast Asia Scoring

Soviets Shoot Down KAL-007.event_text:
Degrade DEFCON one level. US gains 2 VP.
If South Korea is US Controlled, then the US may place Influence or attempt Realignment as if they played a 4 Ops card.
Soviets Shoot Down KAL-007.name: Soviets Shoot Down KAL-007

Special Relationship.event_text:
If UK is US controlled but NATO is not in effect, US adds 1 Influence to any country adjacent to the UK.
If UK is US controlled and NATO is in effect, US adds 2 Influence to any Western European country and gains 2 VPs.
Special Relationship.name: Special Relationship

Stanislav Petrov.event_text:
Play only if DEFCON is 2.
Set DEFCON to 4 or 5.
Stanislav Petrov.name: Stanislav Petrov

Star Wars.event_text: If the US is ahead on the Space Race Track, play this card to search through the discard pile for a non-scoring card of your choice. Event occurs immediately.
Star Wars.name: Star Wars

Suez Crisis.event_text: Remove a total of 4 US Influence from France, the United Kingdom or Israel. Remove no more than 2 Influence per country.
Suez Crisis.name: Suez Crisis

Summit.event_text: Both players roll a die.  Each adds 1 for each Region they Dominate or Control. High roller gains 2 VP and may move DEFCON marker one level in either direction. Do not reroll ties.
Summit.name: Summit

Tear Down This Wall.event_text:
Cancels/prevent Willy Brandt.
Add 3 US Influence in East Germany.
Then US may make a free Coup attempt or Realignment rolls in Europe using this card's Ops Value.
Tear Down This Wall.name: Tear Down This Wall

Terrorism.event_text:
Opponent must randomly discard one card. If played by USSR and Iranian Hostage Crisis is in effect, the US player must randomly discard two cards.
(Events on discards do not occur.)
Terrorism.name: Terrorism

The Cambridge Five.event_text: The US player exposes all scoring cards in their hand. The USSR player may then add 1 Influence in any single region named on one of those scoring cards (USSR choice). Cannot be played as an event in Late War.
The Cambridge Five.name: The Cambridge Five

The China Card.event_text:
Begins the game with the USSR player.
+1 Operations value when all points are used in Asia. Pass to opponent after play.
+1 VP for the player holding this card at the end of Turn 10.
Cancels effect of 'Formosan Resolution' if this card is played by the US player.
The China Card.name: The China Card

The Iron Lady.event_text:
US gains 1 VP.
Add 1 USSR Influence in Argentina. Remove all USSR Influence from UK.
Socialist Governments event no longer playable.
The Iron Lady.name: The Iron Lady

The Reformer.event_text:
Add 4 Influence in Europe (no more than 2 per country). If USSR is ahead of US in VP, then 6 Influence may be added instead.
USSR may no longer conduct Coup attempts in Europe.
Improves effect of Glasnost event.
The Reformer.name: The Reformer

The Voice Of America.event_text: Remove 4 USSR Influence from non-European countries. No more than 2 may be removed from any one country.
The Voice Of America.name: The Voice Of America

Truman Doctrine.event_text: Remove all USSR Influence markers in one uncontrolled country in Europe.
Truman Doctrine.name: Truman Doctrine

U2 Incident.event_text:
USSR gains 1VP.
If UN Intervention played later this turn as an Event, either by US or USSR, gain 1 additional VP.
U2 Incident.name: U2 Incident

UN Intervention.event_text: Play this card simultaneously with a card containing your opponent's associated Event. The Event is cancelled, but you may use its Operations value to Conduct Operations. The cancelled event returns to the discard pile. May not be played during headline phase.
UN Intervention.name: UN Intervention

US/Japan Mutual Defense Pact.event_text: US gains sufficient Influence in Japan for Control. USSR may no longer make Coup or Realignment rolls in Japan.
US/Japan Mutual Defense Pact.name: US/Japan Mutual Defense Pact

Ussuri River Skirmish.event_text: If the USSR has 'The China Card', claim it face up and available for play. If the US already has 'The China Card', add 4 US Influence in Asia, no more than 2 per country.
Ussuri River Skirmish.name: Ussuri River Skirmish

VE Day.event_text:
1:   Soviets advance past Elbe. Apply the 2-3 result, and the USSR receives 1 Influence in West Germany and 1 in Austria during setup.
2/3: Wehrmacht collapses; Soviets overrun Eastern Europe before Christmas. USSR receives 2 additional Eastern Europe Influence during setup.
4/5: Soviets reach Berlin first. No effect.
6:   A bridge just far enough. Western Allies reach Berlin first. Both players receive 2 Influence in East Germany (for USSR this is in lieu of that specifically placed in East Germany, but their general Eastern Europe Influence may be placed there normally). Replace the Europe Scoring card with the Allied Berlin version. Blockade event has no effect.
VE Day.name: VE Day

VJ Day.event_text:
1:   Soviets invade Manchuria and Korea in early 1945. Apply the 2-3 result. Then, move the US/Japan Mutual Defense Pact card to the Mid War deck and add 1 USSR Influence in each of Japan and South Korea during setup.
2/3: "Committees" penetrate southern Korea. Soviets receive 1 Influence in South Korea during setup.
4/5: Soviets declare was on Japan in August 1945. No effect.
6:   Japan surrenders after Hiroshima bomb; Stalin reins in surrogates. Remove the Korean War card from the game. On Turn 1, US ignores DEFCON restrictions and DEFCON cannot go below 2.
VJ Day.name: VJ Day

Vietnam Revolts.event_text: Add 2 USSR Influence in Vietnam. For the remainder of the turn, the Soviet player may add 1 Operations point to any card that uses all points in Southeast Asia.
Vietnam Revolts.name: Vietnam Revolts

Wargames.event_text:
If DEFCON Status 2, you may immediately end the game (without Final Scoring Phase) after giving opponent 6 VPs.
How about a nice game of chess?
Wargames.name: Wargames

_seq.description: Remove 4 US Countries in Eastern Europe
Add 5 USSR Influence in Eastern Europe

Warsaw Pact Formed.event_text: Remove all US Influence from four countries in Eastern Europe, or add 5 USSR Influence in Eastern Europe, adding no more than 2 per country. Allow play of NATO.
Warsaw Pact Formed.name: Warsaw Pact Formed

We Will Bury You.event_text:
Unless UN Invervention is played as an Event on the US player's next round, USSR gains 3 VP prior to any US VP award.
Degrade DEFCON one level.
We Will Bury You.name: We Will Bury You

Who Lost China.event_text:
If the USSR holds the China Card, reset US Military Operations to zero.
If playing with the Chinese Civil War variant, this card cannot be played if Chinese Civil War is still in effect.
Who Lost China.name: Who Lost China

Willy Brandt.event_text:
USSR receives gains 1 VP.
USSR receives 1 Influence in West Germany.
Cancels NATO for West Germany.
This event unplayable and/or cancelled by Tear Down This Wall.
Willy Brandt.name: Willy Brandt

Yalta and Potsdam.event_text:
1:   FDR attends Potsdam in poor health; misreads Stalin's intentions. USSR receives 1 additional Influence anywhere in Europe during setup and may take one of Vietnam Revolts or Arab-Israeli War into hand before drawing cards (it still counts against hand limit).
2/3: FDR attends Yalta but dies before Potsdam. No effect.
4/5: FDR too ill to attend Yalta; Truman recognizes Soviet intentions in Eastern Europe. The US may take Marshall Plan into hand before drawing cards for Turn 1 (it still counts against hand limit).
6:   FDR dies just before the Yalta Conference; Truman takes hard line with Soviets. Apply the 4-5 result, and the US goes first in all Early War turns.
Yalta and Potsdam.name: Yalta and Potsdam

Yuri and Samantha.event_text: USSR receives 1 VP for each US coup attempt made for the remainder of the current turn.
Yuri and Samantha.name: Yuri and Samantha
